name: catalog-001-baseline
statements: CREATE TABLE product_presets(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT product_presets_description_not_blank CHECK(length(trim(description))>0),unit_price TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT product_presets_unit_price_shape CHECK(unit_price !~ '[^0-9.]' AND unit_price ~ '^[0-9].*\.[0-9][0-9]$' AND length(unit_price)-length(replace(unit_price,'.',''))=1),unit_code TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT product_presets_unit_code_length CHECK(length(unit_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 3),unit_name TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT product_presets_unit_name_length CHECK(length(unit_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),preferred_vat_rate_code TEXT CONSTRAINT product_presets_vat_rate_code_length CHECK(preferred_vat_rate_code IS NULL OR length(preferred_vat_rate_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 32),UNIQUE(organization_id,id))
CREATE INDEX product_presets_organization ON product_presets(organization_id,(translate(description,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ','abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz')) COLLATE "C",id COLLATE "C")
